urls.rationale: Chapter 13A - Lobbying Disclosure: the active PA lobbying-disclosure statute body (65 Pa.C.S. ch. 13A).

notes: Chapter 13 (Lobby Regulation and Disclosure) is marked 'Deleted by amendment' and excluded (prior repealed regime). Chapter 11 (Ethics Standards and Financial Disclosure) is general public-officer ethics, not lobbying-coupled, excluded consistent with PA 2015 rationale.
